description: Events every service writes (normative). A service's own catalogue must not repeat these names; contract-check merges this file into every catalogue.

service.starting.description: The process started and read its settings; nothing is served yet.

service.ready.description: Every readiness check passed: the healthy file is written, traffic may come.

service.not_ready.description: A readiness check fails; attrs.failing names the checks.

service.draining.description: Draining began (cause: the signal or operator action): no new work is taken.

service.stopped.description: The process is exiting with attrs.exit_code.

service.panic.description: An unexpected crash (a Rust panic, an uncaught Java error): error.stack holds the stack.

config.loaded.description: A configuration file or document was read and accepted (attrs.file).

config.refused.description: A configuration file or document was refused; the old one stays (attrs.file).

log.dropped.description: Records were dropped because the log queue was full (attrs.dropped since the last report). The seq gap shows where.

dependency.unavailable.description: A dependency (attrs.dependency: kafka, etcd, postgres, redis, routing, telephony) can't be reached; the service retries.

dependency.restored.description: The dependency in attrs.dependency answers again.
